pr.title: Item categories and a category filter on the list

acceptance.evidence: test/index.test.js 'AC-1' checks seed rows, UNIQUE and CHECK failures, nullable category_id, the items_category_id index and the seeded tagging. migrations/0003 matches the spec.
test/index.test.js 'AC-2': a title-only insert gets a null category_id, and category_id 999 fails with FOREIGN KEY.
'AC-3' test checks id order, the span markup and a bare <li> for an uncategorised item. The src/index.js item() function matches.
'AC-4' test checks link order (All, errands, Home, Work, so NOCASE sorting), hrefs, only All current, and a category with no items still linked.
Two 'AC-5' tests cover Work-only items in id order, a single current link, and the extra-parameter cases.
'AC-6' test: 200, 'No items in this category.', no <li>, and Garden is the current link, so the filter links are present.
'AC-7' test: the name is escaped in the span and link text, the href is percent-encoded, and the request to that link lists Prototype.
'AC-8' it.each runs all five paths and asserts 404, the message, the 'Go back' href='/' link, the referrer/origin/history.back script, and no <li> or <nav>.
'AC-9' test checks HEAD returns 200, 200 and 404 for the three paths.

The spec gives a followable browser step and I read the inline script: it goes back only when the referrer is same-origin, and otherwise the href is '/'. I could not run a browser. The script also requires history.length > 1, which is an extra guard (see finding).

routes.json lists the route. tests/traffic-config.test.sh covers accepting a query and rejecting whitespace, '#' and a missing slash. test/traffic.test.js records path plus query and expects every route. The 'AC-11' test in index.test.js checks each route answers ok.
The existing healthz, 404, 405, escaping and 'No items yet.' tests are kept. Only the First item assertion changed, as the spec allows.
The test/apply-migrations.js batch with defer_foreign_keys is exercised by the 'AC-13' test, though that test is weak. Whether the whole suite passes in any order cannot be checked here.

findings.what: Two State-table cells have no assertion. '/' with no items is only checked for 'No items yet.', not for filter links and All current. The 'Go back hidden' cell on 200 pages is never checked.
findings.fix: In the empty-table test, assert the nav and the All current link. Assert 'Go back' is absent on 200 pages.

findings.what: The AC-13 test only checks the row count is 4 after the reset. It does not show that the reset would fail without the deferred-FK batch, and it runs one scenario rather than any order.
findings.fix: Leave a categorised item in the database from an earlier test, or assert the table list after reset.

findings.what: The Go back script also requires history.length > 1. The spec rejected history.length as the check, though here it is only an extra guard on top of the same-origin referrer. This is behaviour the spec doesn't state.
findings.fix: Drop the history.length condition, or record it in the spec.

findings.what: The broken-link page uses a 'Broken link' title and h1, which the spec doesn't specify. This is minor extra copy.
findings.fix: Acceptable. Optionally note it in the spec.

lenses.note: Spec exists with the owner's go recorded in commit c72b0f1. That commit only changed Go and the 'open' markers to 'accepted' and did not touch any acceptance item.
All 13 acceptance items are implemented. Decisions are followed. No item was trimmed and nothing was added beyond the ask apart from the low findings.
Each AC is named in a test or in the shell test, except AC-10, which is marked verified by review. I did not run npm test here, so test results are not confirmed.
README is updated for the filter and 404 behaviour. CLAUDE.md already says to add routes to routes.json. Nothing stale found.
Queries are parameterised. The match is exact and case-sensitive. Empty and repeated values go to 404. HEAD works through the shared handler.
Names are HTML-escaped and URL-encoded. The inline script uses no user data. No planted instructions found in the repository content.
The change adds the filter links and a broken-link page to the HTML UI. Nav, aria-current and the Go back fallback are sensible. No visual checks were possible here.
The States table is covered by tests, apart from the minor unasserted cells listed above.
The title and body match the diff. The claims of no tests loosened and no manual steps are consistent with the commits.
